```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forecast)
library(tseries)
library(lubridate)
```

```{r}
# Import Excel file
wsts <- read_excel("BF Final project data.xlsx", sheet = 1)

# Convert Date column
wsts$Date <- as.Date(wsts$Date)

# Check data
head(wsts)

# Check structure
str(wsts)

# Check column names
names(wsts)
```

```{r}
# set up Data

wsts_long <- wsts %>%
  select(Date, Americas, Europe, Japan,
         `Asia Pacific`, Worldwide) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Date,
    names_to = "Region",
    values_to = "Sales"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sales_Billion = Sales / 1000000,
    Region = factor(
      Region,
      levels = c("Worldwide", "Americas",
                 "Europe", "Japan", "Asia Pacific")
    )
  )

head(wsts_long)
```

```{r}
ggplot(wsts_long,
       aes(x = Date, y = Sales_Billion,
           color = Region)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +

  # Mark growth acceleration
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.Date("2025-09-01"),
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  annotate(
    "label",
    x = as.Date("2024-12-01"),
    y = 165,
    label = "Growth Acceleration\nSep 2025",
    color = "red",
    size = 4
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Worldwide" = "black",
      "Americas" = "purple",
      "Europe" = "blue",
      "Japan" = "green",
      "Asia Pacific" = "orange"
    )
  ) +

  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 year",
    date_labels = "%Y"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Monthly Semiconductor Sales by Region",
    subtitle = "January 2016 - August 2026",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Sales (Billion USD)",
    color = "Region",
    caption = "Source: WSTS Historical Billings Report"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(wsts_growth,
       aes(x = Date, y = YoY_Growth)) +
  geom_line(color = "purple", linewidth = 1) +

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray50"
  ) +

  # Mark growth acceleration
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.Date("2025-09-01"),
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  annotate(
    "label",
    x = as.Date("2024-03-01"),
    y = 150,
    label = "Growth Acceleration\nSep 2025",
    color = "red",
    size = 3.5
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Global Semiconductor Sales YoY Growth",
    subtitle = "January 2016 - August 2026",
    x = "Year",
    y = "YoY Growth (%)",
    caption = "Source: WSTS Historical Billings Report"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

```{r}
library(forecast)

# Create monthly time series
sales_ts <- ts(
  wsts$Worldwide / 1000000,
  start = c(2016, 1),
  frequency = 12
)

# Check time series
start(sales_ts)
end(sales_ts)
frequency(sales_ts)
```

```{r}
acf(
  sales_ts,
  lag.max = 36,
  main = "ACF of Global Semiconductor Sales"
)
```

```{r}
# Additive Decomposition
plot(decompose(sales_ts, type = "additive"))

# Multiplicative Decomposition
plot(decompose(sales_ts, type = "multiplicative"))
```

# Naive Model
```{r}
# Naive Forecast
naive_model <- naive(sales_ts, h = 12)

# summary
summary(naive_model)

# Plot
plot(naive_model,
     main = "Naive Forecast - Global Semiconductor Sales",
     xlab = "Year",
     ylab = "Sales (Billion USD)",
     col = "blue")


```

#Naive Residual
```{r}
# Residuals
naive_res <- residuals(naive_model)

# Plot residuals
plot(naive_res,
     main = "Naive Method - Residual Plot",
     xlab = "Year",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     col = "blue",
     lwd = 1)

abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
```

# Histogram of Residual
```{r}
hist(naive_res,
     main = "Naive Method - Histogram of Residuals",
     xlab = "Residuals",
     ylab = "Frequency",
     col = "lightblue",
     border = "white")

abline(v = 0, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
```

# Fitted Value v.s Residual
```{r}
# Fitted Value
naive_fitted <- fitted(naive_model)
plot(naive_fitted)

# Fitted Values vs Residuals
plot(as.numeric(naive_fitted),
     as.numeric(naive_res),
     main = "Naive Method - Fitted vs Residuals",
     xlab = "Fitted Values",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     col = "blue",
     pch = 19)

# Reference line
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
```

#Actual vs Residual
```{r}
naive_actual <- as.numeric(sales_ts)
naive_res <- as.numeric(residuals(naive_model))

plot(naive_actual, naive_res,
     main = "Naive Method - Actual vs Residuals",
     xlab = "Actual Values",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     col = "blue",
     pch = 19)

abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
```

# ACF
```{r}
# Since first month has no previous observation, there will be NA in the data list. We need to remove the NA and do the ACF, using no.omit

acf(na.omit(naive_res),
    lag.max = 36, 
    main = "Naive Method - ACF of Residuals")

```

# Moving Average
```{r}
mavg3_forecast = ma(sales_ts,order=3)
mavg6_forecast = ma(sales_ts,order=6)
mavg9_forecast = ma(sales_ts,order=9) 
plot(sales_ts, main = "Plot along with moving averages")
lines(mavg3_forecast, col="Red")
lines(mavg6_forecast, col="Blue")
lines(mavg9_forecast, col="Green")

legend("topleft",
       legend = c("Actual Sales", "MA3", "MA6", "MA9"),
       col = c("black", "red", "blue", "green"),
       lty = 1,
       lwd = 2,
       bty = "n")
```

```{r}
MA3_forecast <- forecast(mavg3_forecast, h = 12)
summary(MA3_forecast)
plot(MA3_forecast)
```

# Residual of MA3 Analysis
```{r}
# Residuals
MA3_res <- residuals(MA3_forecast)

     main = "MA3 - Residual Plot",
     xlab = "Year",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     col = "blue",
     lwd = 1)

abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
```


# Holt Winters
```{r}
# Holt-Winters Multiplicative Forecast: Next 12 Months
hw_model <- hw(sales_ts,
               seasonal = "multiplicative",
               h = 12)

# Show model output
summary(hw_model)

# Plot forecast
plot(hw_model,
     main = "Holt-Winters Forecast - Global Semiconductor Sales",
     xlab = "Year",
     ylab = "Sales (Billion USD)",
     col = "blue")
```

# ARIMA model
```{r}
# Check differencing
ndiffs(sales_ts)

#Check seasonal differencing
nsdiffs(sales_ts)
```

```{r}
tsdisplay(sales_ts)
tsdisplay(diff(sales_ts, diffferences = 2))
```

# ARIMA Forecast
```{r}
auto_fit_sales = auto.arima(sales_ts, trace=TRUE, stepwise = FALSE)
auto_fit_sales
```

```{r}
plot(forecast(auto_fit_sales, h = 12, level=c(99.5)))
```

# Summary of ARIMA
```{r}
summary(forecast(auto_fit_sales, h = 12, level=c(99.5)))
```

# Residual Analysis of ARIMA
```{r}
#ACF
Acf(auto_fit_sales$residuals)
```

# Histogram of Residual
```{r}
hist(auto_fit_sales$residuals)
abline(v = 0, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
```


# Box test - Ljung
```{r}
Box.test(residuals(auto_fit_sales),
         lag = 20,
         type = "Ljung-Box",
         fitdf = 4)V
```

```{r}
plot.ts(residuals(auto_fit_sales), main = "ARIMA - Residual plot")
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
```

```{r}
tsdiag(auto_fit_sales)
```
